limitations: GPQA and coding are partial-regeneration results: original short responses were retained; all preselected long/capped and missing responses were generated under the recorded policy. They are not fresh uniform full runs.
Regeneration selection ignored correctness. One formerly correct response became incorrect in each lane; the new outcomes were retained rather than selecting the better attempt.
Actual loaded-file hashes and KV precision remain unverified. Public source hashes do not prove the loaded files; formal local chart observations are not exported until artifact verification.

Inference engines, effective server defaults, and reasoning closure handling differ from Halogen. Terminal-Bench is a deadline-limited deployment comparison with service contention, not a controlled quant-only comparison.
Timing fields are cumulative over selected requests/trials. They omit excluded transport/user-interrupted attempts and probe requests; discarded-original request time is itemized separately.
Native responses do not report forced-closure markers; absent markers are not interpreted as zero forced closures.
Wilson intervals describe task-sampling uncertainty, not all model or run variability.
